name: SRIDGE
recent: Silver Ridge 于 2026 年 11 月完成私募配售，以每股 RM0.105 发行 3980 万股新股，并因 ESOS 行使而多次增加上市股份。公司于 2026 年 11 月 27 日公布 2027 财年第一季度业绩，营收同比大增 381% 至 RM2490 万，并转亏为盈。此外，公司将于 2026 年 12 月 11 日召开第 21 届年度股东大会。
notable: 完成私募配售，以每股 RM0.105 发行 3980 万股新股，占已发行股份约 10%。
2027 财年第一季度营收同比大增 381% 至 RM2490 万，并转亏为盈。
因员工购股权计划（ESOS）行使，分别于 2026 年 11 月 5 日及 25 日增加上市股份。
risks: 私募配售发行新股可能摊薄现有股东持股比例。
董事 Tan Kok Chin 在闭门交易期于 2026 年 11 月 26 日以每股 RM0.105 增持 100 万股。
公司于 2026 年 10 月 23 日公告拟更改公司名称为 Tangerine Holdings Bhd。
earnings: 2026 财年（截至 6 月 30 日）全年营收 RM1517.5 万，净亏损 RM135.3 万，净利率 -8.9%；营收同比增 162.9%，但净利同比降 388.5%，由盈转亏。

recent_en: Silver Ridge completed a private placement in November 2026, issuing 39.8 million new shares at RM0.105 each, and made several additional listings of shares from ESOS exercises. The company announced its 1Q FY2027 results on 27 November 2026, with revenue up 381% year-on-year to RM24.9 million and a swing to profit.
notable_en: Completed a private placement of 39.8 million new shares at RM0.105 each, representing about 10% of issued shares.
1Q FY2027 revenue surged 381% year-on-year to RM24.9 million, swinging to a profit.
Additional shares were listed on 5 and 25 November 2026 due to ESOS exercises.
risks_en: The private placement of new shares may dilute existing shareholders' stakes.
Director Tan Kok Chin acquired 1,000,000 shares at RM0.105 on 26 November 2026 during the closed period.
The company announced a proposed change of name to Tangerine Holdings Bhd on 23 October 2026.
earnings_en: FY2026 (ended 30 June) revenue was RM15.175 million with a net loss of RM1.353 million, a net margin of -8.9%; revenue rose 162.9% year-on-year while net income fell 388.5%, swinging from profit to loss.
